caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet consisting of two main sections: an upper shelving unit and a lower storage compartment. The upper section features three horizontal shelves with wavy, decorative side panels and a flat top surface, all rendered in shades of brown to mimic wood grain. The back of the shelving unit has visible vertical panel lines. The lower section is a rectangular box with two plain doors, also shaded and textured to represent wood grain, and small dark metal hinges and handles. The entire cabinet is illustrated in warm brown tones, with detailed shading to highlight the wood texture. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a small signature or inscription in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Kitchen Cupboard
